modalLead: Hotfix after v2026.08.08.2 — sharing a bookmark from the right-click menu works on the first attempt again, and a confirmation toast no longer waits behind the Shift+B tip. Both were silent: the share simply did nothing, and the toast arrived up to fourteen seconds after the action it was confirming.

items.text: Share from the right-click menu reaches the clipboard again — resolving a row to its bookmark went through the lazy loader's generic path, which answers with a Promise until the module is fetched. Callers read the bookmark straight away, got nothing, and did nothing, so a share never fell through to its clipboard copy. The loader now answers this one synchronously, like the share labels beside it (dashboard-bookmark-interactions-loader.js).

Confirmations no longer wait behind the Shift+B tip — that tip holds the toast area for fourteen seconds, and anything raised while it was up sat in the queue behind it. A change you had just made was confirmed long after the fact, or looked like it had not registered at all. A real notification now takes the slot instead of waiting (app-notification.js).
